title: The Broken Trail
author: Freya Halloran
blurb: Noor Galloway, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, has spent ten years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
